faq.a: Switzerland has excellent roads, strict technical inspections and transparent vehicle history. Mileage is genuine and the technical condition is usually above the European average.

faq.q: How long does an on-order delivery take?
faq.a: On average 2–5 weeks depending on the model: sourcing and inspection in Switzerland, transport and registration paperwork in Moldova.

faq.q: Can I verify the car's history?
faq.a: Yes. We provide the VIN for every car and, on request, a history report and an independent technical inspection before purchase.
A sales contract, verified history, and for on-order cars — a documented technical inspection before transport.

about.title: About Swiss Cars
